build_DETR_detector: build a python module to instantiate a DETR object detection model with configurable transformer encoder and decoder
run_DETR_pre_transformer: run the DETR pre_transformer method to prepare encoder and decoder inputs from image features and batch data samples
run_DETR_forward_encoder: run the DETR forward_encoder method to process sequential features through the transformer encoder and return memory embeddings
run_DETR_forward_decoder: run the DETR forward_decoder method to process queries against encoder memory and return hidden states for bbox prediction
review_DETR_init_layers: review the DETR _init_layers method to understand how positional encoding, transformer encoder, decoder, and query embeddings are initialized
